programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The baby lemmings are having a picnic but have a nasty tendency to get raspberry juice all over themselves. When one of the baby lemmings dirties baby Raccoon, who has just finished washing up, baby Raccoon decides to take matters into his own hands and wash them. But the baby lemmings get dirty immediately! Baby Raccoon decides to teach them some manners!

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Redbird struggles to stop Poison Ivy's diabolical schemes because he wants to be in the spotlight. But when he needs to use the bat-o-flage and become invisible, he’ll have to learn that doing good is its own reward.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: With Bibi in need of repairs, Batgirl takes Bam out for a spin to stop Mr. Freeze's latest icy crime spree. Bam will have to get used to having Batgirl in the driver's seat and learn something new if he's going to help her stop Mr. Freeze!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to impress Irma who is infatuated with the hunky deliveryman. Bean tries to improve his physique at the gym but has little success. Instead he opts for an inflatable muscle suit. Irma is indeed impressed and Bean’s plan seems to be working – until the suit gets punctured and Bean makes the mistake of re-inflating it with helium. As Bean floats off into the sky will Irma’s admiration be punctured?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is initially charmed when a seemingly cute seagull turns up on his windowsill. Bean feeds the gull and invites the bird inside. But it’s not long before the seagull in the flat turns out to be a cuckoo in the nest taking over Bean’s home – eating all his food controlling the TV and sleeping in his bed. Bean starts to regret taking on a new best friend in place of good old reliable Teddy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night, especially when he needs the toilet?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean needs to clean up after working on his car. However each time he tries to get in the bath, he’s interrupted by plumbers who are doing work in Mrs Wicket’s bathroom. When they turn off the hot water and head off to lunch, leaving Mrs Wicket’s new bath on the front lawn, Mr Bean decides enough is enough. He fills the outdoor bath up and has a soak right there in view of everyone!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it. Once equipped with the right tools, he ventures into the countryside with a blank canvas in search of inspiration – and comes home with a painting full of life. Literally.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: Fred gets a call for help from Chuck Mangum (JOHN VIENER), his daredevil of a best friend, leading the gang on a rescue mission deep in the caverns of an ancient civilization. Once there, they learn of the real mystery: the ghost of the Tribal Warrior that still protects the cavern from outsiders!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 1
programme.desc: It's Scooby's dream come true as the gang visits the set of his favorite TV show and he meets the star, his celebrity crush, a dog actress who plays a detective on the screen. Now all Scooby has to do is work up the courage to actually talk to her while also solving the mystery of the monstrous Gargoyle attacking the production!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that oysters can make pearls almost instantaneously: just put an object inside their shell and it’s automatically coated with mother-of-pearl The game of marbles that the Lemmings have invented with pearls is driving Grizzy crazy. He manages to catapult the Lemmings far away. But at the ocean bottom, they discover a giant oyster. All they need to create a giant-scale marble game!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings have adopted a small exotic fish that’s lively and affectionate and have fun decorating its aquarium. Jealous, Grizzy finds a fish too, but his is expressionless and indifferent to the bear’s efforts to communicate. Grizzy plots to exchange the two fish behind the Lemmings' backs. He puts the affectionate fish in an even bigger aquarium with a pharaonic decor and locks the lid. But the Lemmings have no intention of leaving their friend to Grizzy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings use all the cans and tins they can get their hands on to build a beach slide. Grizzy, annoyed at not finding his tinned fish to prepare his meal tray, recovers them from the Lemmings. In their struggle, Grizzy loses his badge! Grizzy and the Lemmings now fight over a valuable metal detector that each party needs to accomplish their goal: build a slide or find the beloved badge.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings take a liking to an endangered crab on the beach and decide to shelter it from a seagull who is using its shell to open coconuts. They bring it home to a disgruntled Grizzy, who wants to watch TV in peace while snacking on Cheetos. When the Lemmings turn into full-fledged crab rescuers, the house is soon overrun with crustaceans. Grizzy decides to use the seagull to get rid of the crabs. But the Lemmings - ready to do anything to protect their new friends - embark the entire house, like a raft on water.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings play pirates on a beached boat. Grizzy, who is fishing further down, realizes that with the Lemmings’ boat, he could come closer to a zone that’s teeming with fish. Grizzy takes a malicious pleasure playing pirate himself to unseat the Lemmings and steal their boat. The Lemmings discover a chest containing real pirate belongings. A telescope conjures the owner’s ghost who immediately places his saber and hook at their disposal.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy sets sail with his fishing gear. But he has no intention of fishing: it's a scheme to enjoy a jar of Yummy chocolate spread alone in peace. The Lemmings sense the subterfuge and sink his boat to get the treat, which sinks to the ocean depths. The characters dive in pursuit and discover a school of intelligent crabs that live in an underwater city. Their treasure is a substance that’s even yummier than Yummy.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean wins two tickets for an exotic cruise and naturally he takes Teddy along for the trip of a lifetime. Once aboard the huge ocean liner Mr Bean soon settles into a life of luxury but while showing off to a new friend Bean becomes ‘man overboard’ and stranded on a dessert island. The hungrier he gets the wilder he becomes and desperate to find a way off the island.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his favourite china shop to buy a new cup for Teddy but when he opens his wallet he doesn’t have enough money to pay for it. When he sees a poster for the local funfair where the stalls have cash prizes Bean is determined to win himself some money on the Coconut Shy. But after many unsuccessful attempts he realises it’s a fix and lets everyone know about it. Naturally this doesn’t go down well with the stallholder who wants revenge and a chase around the funfair ensues.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean’s electricity supply is cut off when Mrs Wicket sees the cost of her enormous electricity bill. As the snow falls outside Mr Bean’s flat becomes so cold that there are ice cubes in his bath water. Mr Bean has the idea to build a huge wind turbine in the back garden providing his own power. All is going very well until an unexpected storm sends Bean’s wind turbine into overdrive creating a huge surge of electricity and a huge shock for everyone

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean goes to his local bakery to buy a cake but finds he doesn’t have any money. He goes to the bank to use the cash machine but he can’t remember his pin number. When Mr Bean's bankcard is swallowed up by the cash machine there’s only one thing to do - go into the machine and fetch it back. The police are alerted but Bean’s main concern is to get some money and get back to the baker’s before all the cakes are sold.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: When nursing an injured magpie in his room, Mr. Bean learns something the rest of us already know: magpies can’t help stealing anything that sparkles. When the police arrive to investigate the theft of his landlady’s jewellery, it’s not just Mr. Bean that needs to take flight.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 2
programme.desc: Redbird is convinced that nobody likes his eccentric dance moves, but when Toyman traps Robin behind a dance-themed gauntlet, it’s up to the rambunctious rally car to dance his way to victory.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 3
programme.desc: Catwoman has her eyes on the prize at Gotham's big skateboarding competition, and it's up to Robin and Nightwing to stop her -- with some help from Ace!

programme.title: Meet the Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Bam can't wait to recharge after a long night of heroism in Gotham, but first, the Batwheels need all kinds of help, delaying his much-needed nap just a little bit longer...

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: Finally fed up with monsters and mayhem, Shaggy and Scooby decide to quit the gang and train their replacements in one on-the-job training session, unraveling the mystery of a vampire that's terrorizing a small town.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: After a Giant Houndbeast attacks an elite dog show, the gang goes undercover and enters Scooby in the show in order to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: The Lemmings find a racket game linked to a prize distributor on a gas station parking lot. The more times you hit the ball without letting it touch the ground, the bigger the prize. With a series of 1,000 consecutive exchanges, the prize is a giant jar of Yummy chocolate spread! Grizzy has no qualms about cheating to win, but the outcome against the Lemmings is never certain. For they have nerves of steel when the stakes are high.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy uses insecticide and a fly swatter to get rid of vermin that are bothering him during his siesta. The Lemmings heal his last victim: a cute little insect they adopt as their house pet. Only problem, their starving mascot only eats wood! The cabin has lots of it, but when Grizzy realizes that an insect is eating his home from the inside, he takes drastic measures to eliminate it permanently.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 4
programme.desc: Grizzy is too hot and proposes the Lemmings an exchange: their ventilator, which they use to propel their skateboard in the air, for a baby ostrich Grizzy found outside the cabin and who can tow them. The Lemmings are delighted to play with their new baby friend who is overflowing with energy. But the baby’s parents have a different outlook and do not want their son taking risks. Thinking that Grizzy is the Lemmings’ father, they hold him accountable.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have placed giant remote-controlled hydraulic jacks under the cabin to transform it into a life-sized rolling ball game. Grizzy, who in inclined to seasickness, tries to put things back in place. The cabin tips over into empty space.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is disturbed during his nap by a few uncatchable flies which buzz incessantly around his head. When he realizes that the carnivorous plant upon which the Lemmings are playing rodeo feeds off flying insects, he decides to confiscate it and use it as an anti-fly weapon.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a crate of competition boomerangs. They rapidly become pros capable of disarming Grizzy at a distance and ejecting him from the cabin with disconcerting ease. To compete with the precision of the Lemming boomerangs, Grizzy decides to learn archery and becomes the Canadian William Tell.

programme.title: Lamput - Season 3
programme.desc: “Chasing Lamput” turns out to be the ultimate backstage pass; the Docs pursue the orange blob through the dressing room and directly onto the stage of a gigantic stadium rock concert. The crowd goes wild. Which raises questions about their taste in music, to be honest; Skinny plays guitar like he’s gotten himself tangled in the strings (which he has), and Specs’ drumming, well, it’s certainly got passion. No taste, skill or rhythm, but certainly passion. The stage ends up in tatters by the time the actual band arrives. Those Docs are a hard act to follow.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Meet Atticus Tinhorn, Clara’s greedy, scheming uncle—who wants to claim Dino Island for himself! There’s just one problem… the Cassidys already call it home! Determined to drive them off once and for all, he cooks up a ridiculous (and ridiculously dangerous) plan: smear Boboberry Jam all over the Cassidys to lure the island’s giant fire ants into carrying them away for good!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers - Season 1
programme.desc: Uncle Jack and Jon are busy gathering crates of coco-nanas! They know not to go home through Swarm Valley, home to giant dragonflies that love them! Jack and Jon take the safe route, when the Tinhorns swoop in from their hot air balloon and snatch the entire crate from them! Atticus steers the balloon straight toward Swarm Valley, unaware that he’s flying straight into a buzzing nightmare!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees Mr Paliwal practising for a local table tennis tournament and decides he wants to enter to try to win the cash prize. He goes home, adapts his dining table into a table tennis table, and designs an ingenious ball-firing machine using a foot pump and vacuum hose. None of this helps much, and Mr Bean worries he’s not improving – but could this new device be adapted and answer his problems?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean sees a new toy car in the window of the local department store Havlotts and decides he must have it. But on the way to the toy department Mr Bean gets stuck in the lift. He tries his best to entertain his fellow passengers but they aren’t very appreciative. How can Mr Bean resolve the situation and get the toy he so desperately wants?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean attempts to build a shady gazebo in the back garden on a scorching hot day. But as he digs into the ground he unearths a huge unexploded bomb. Trying to make Mrs Wicket aware of the danger and save Scrapper and Teddy from being blown to smithereens takes courage nerve and a Bean styled homemade bomb disposal kit.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: Determined to master Beethoven’s symphony, Mr Bean wangles himself a grand piano, a music book, a candelabra and a very patient piano teacher. Liberace, eat your heart out!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Winter has come! The Baby Lemmings discover the pure joy of sliding and playing on the ice. Their neighbor Baby Moose is not at all as delighted with the new weather conditions as they are – already naturally fearful, he’s thrown into a complete panic when his surroundings turn icy, cold and… sharp! He decides to secure the zone by breaking up all the frozen ice puddles and smashing all the icicles in his vicinity including the Baby Lemmings’ icicles. But his phobia causes him to fall into the middle of a frozen lake, and the Baby Lemmings have to rescue him.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: Baby Moose is dismayed by the recklessness of the Baby Lemmings, who wander through the forest oblivious to the dangers around them. Exhausted by having to save them from small dangers, he decides instead to teach them the rudiments of safety and equip them with protective gear. But the Baby Lemmings aren't too keen on this.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings - Season 1
programme.desc: The Baby Lemmings are playing a game with a moss ball that falls apart too quickly. They discover a hazel tree with huge hazelnuts that are perfect for making their game even more fun! Their neighbor, Baby Chipmunk, who has the largest stockpile of hazelnuts in the whole forest and a veritable internal radar for detecting them, quickly realizes that the Baby Lemmings have found one. She can’t help but steal it for his own hoard. The Baby Lemmings realize that Baby Chipmunk hates to share so they decide to get their ball back and continue their game. Baby Chipmunk’s hoard is very well protected in a hollow tree, however.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: A Barbarian and his trusty polar bear Krakos stake claim to the entire forest including Bugs' home.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs and Squeaks head to the African Savannah to visit Squeaks' cousin but first they have to outsmart the very hungry King of the Jungle Thes.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Bugs is excited for a day of fun in the sun but The Winter Stag shows up delivering Winter long before it's due. Bugs intervenes.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes - Season 1
programme.desc: Squeaks has a last minute card game at Bugs' house. Bugs is thrilled until con-artist Shifty shows up to ruin the fun.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: A very bad parking choice on Fred's part leads the gang to an asteroid mining base in outer space where an alien virus appears to be infecting the crew one by one, turning them into evil skull-headed aliens. The paranoid, terrified gang must try to solve the mystery before the virus reaches them, as well – if it hasn't already!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo! - Season 2
programme.desc: To escape a snowstorm, the gang checks into a creepy, massive hotel run by a man very strict about the hotel rules established by his deceased mother. The gang soon discovers the penalty for breaking the hotel rules is a horrifying scolding from the ghost of the owner's mother, herself!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 1
programme.desc: As Mr Bean settles down to watch his favourite TV programme he hears loud noises from next-door. He moves from house to garden but can’t escape the relentless cacophony of trumpets, electric drills, and screaming babies. Bean’s mind turns to thoughts of revenge….

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Tom and Jerry are hired to find a missing priceless Maltese Pigeon.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Tom enlists the help of the lake monster to terrorize the mouse village forcing Jerry Van Mouseling to intervene and save the day.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show - Season 4
programme.desc: Mice visitors from Mars force Tom to change the way he treats Jerry.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy watches a demonstration of balloon modelling on TV. He decides to make a balloon poodle to offer to the she-bear he's enamored with. By observing Grizzy, the Lemmings discover with enthusiasm that you can blow up modelling balloons far more than regular ones, and that they end up exploding in a shower of tattered strips.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy needs a nice nap. He can't find a pillow comfortable enough to his taste until he tests the pillow that the Lemmings use as a high-jump mat. The pillow is so soft that Grizzy falls asleep the second he lays his head on it.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy is awakened from his nap by the unpleasant, ongoing sound of Velcro strips being ripped off. The Lemmings have covered their bodies in Velcro and are throwing themselves against a doormat, which serves as their target. Grizzy finds peace and quiet by getting rid of the doormat until the Lemmings realize that bear fur is an ideal support for Velcro.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The she-bear Grizzy is enamored with has lost her favorite flower in an inaccessible spot under a giant boulder. Grizzy tries to lift it: impossible! He decides to start an intensive bodybuilding routine with the ranger's electrostimulation machine, but the Lemmings are already using it on a caribou to step up their rodeo.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings try to catch a bat to play rodeo, disturbing Grizzy as he plays his favorite game on the ranger's mobile. But when the phone is hit and its alarm activated, a submarine sonar sound is emitted. When the bat hears it, it seems to become docile.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have a blast testing every app on the ranger's tablet one by one. Grizzy, who is starving, sees that the cupboards are bare. When he realizes that one GPS app can give the itinerary to the nearest chocolate spread store, Grizzy requisitions the tablet.

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power - Season 1
programme.desc: Kai suffers a streak of bad luck after a fight with Jynx. It's all bad luck until Lucky O'Green reveals how to break the streak.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Buff trains with Batwing to improve his gracefulness and uses her lessons on a delicate mission against the Riddler.

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Badcomputer captures Bibi and disguises Jestah to take her place with the Batwheels so that Jestah can steal the Batcomputer’s motherboard. Can Bibi get free in time to unmask the imposter and save the day?

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: When the Legion of Zoom plan to cheat their way to winning the Gotham Grand Prix, the Batwheels zoom into action to ensure the race is won the right way - fair and square !

programme.title: Batwheels - Season 1
programme.desc: Green Arrow and his Arrowplane, Goldie, come to help Batman take on the Riddler. Batwing is so happy to have another flying vehicle around that she brings Goldie to life and the two become BFFs. But when Goldie eventually has to leave, Batwing learns that saying goodbye doesn't always mean forever!

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Mayor Leghorn hires The Looney Builders to build a water wheel in the forest where Porky worries about a mythical creature named “Big Feet.”

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: The Looney Builders build Tibs Squirrel a closet in his tree, but it won’t fit all of Tibs’ stuff and he doesn’t want to get rid of anything.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: When The Looney Builders enter a sandcastle building contest, Tweety sees the competition and loses confidence in his idea.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders - Season 1
programme.desc: Chef Hector hires The Looney Builders to build him a burger restaurant, but Daffy is so focused on beating his handheld game that he causes major setbacks.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time - Season 1
programme.desc: Porky tries to eat his sandwich but keeps getting interrupted by the crew who need his help.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean helps Mrs Wicket collect up all her money together after she witnesses a robbery. With all her cash safely locked in a bank vault Mrs Wicket suddenly finds she has a new admirer but Mr Bean doesn’t trust this smooth operator one bit. With wedding bells ringing Mr Bean races against time to solve the mystery and save Mrs Wicket…and her money.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 2
programme.desc: Mr Bean loves Halloween and prepares to give the neighbourhood kids some tricks and treats they won’t forget. But when Mr Bean gets carried away with his spooky pranks he becomes the target of even more fiendish tricks from his neighbours the Bruisers.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean is watching Clint Chiseljaw - his favourite action TV show - with Billy, but Mrs Wicket orders her nephew downstairs to finish his chores. Inspired by Clint’s catchphrase – “Nobody gets left behind”, Mr Bean tries a variety of different daring plans to break Billy out of Mrs Wicket’s flat. But none of them work, until he hits on the perfect plan… or so he thinks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4
programme.desc: Mr Bean peers through the window of the opening party of an art exhibition and sees free snacks being handed around – yum! But he’s told by the bouncer that he needs to be smartly dressed. So he sneaks into the artist’s studio and paints a tuxedo onto himself. This time he’s let in, but will Bean’s fake painted suit last long enough for him to get his free food?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings clumsily destroy the TV remote control while fighting over who gets to watch their favorite program. While looking for a backup zapper, they happen onto a top secret Canadian Army prototype that enables you to apply the usual controls: play, pause and fast forward to living beings.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings discover that by changing the speed limit sign on the side of the road, they can accelerate truck traffic and create a huge draft that is just perfect for their extreme kiting game. Grizzy would be more in favor of a 20261119234500 +0000! or No Entrance! sign. A road sign battle begins.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: While trying to stop the Lemmings from playing their extreme trampoline game, Grizzy slips on the canvas and unwittingly executes an amazing somersault in front of his beloved she-bear. Seeing that she wants more, Grizzy decides to become a champ in the sport. But for that to happen, the Lemmings will need to let him work out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have hitched up a racoon with a sweet tooth to their sled and get a ride by throwing cookies in front of the creature with a sling. To recover the supply of cookies, which were to be his afternoon snack, Grizzy has no qualms about making the Lemmings' sled skid out of control. When the sled hits a superhero's spacecraft, a mysterious costume falls out.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings have unearthed a strange little gadget from amongst the Forest Ranger's belongings: a hand spinner. Grizzy thinks it's a silly game until he accidentally tries out the contraption for himself and becomes instantly addicted. What is the secret of this seemingly banal object that make the heads of its enthusiasts spin as well?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings play with poseable figurines of wild Canadian animals. When Grizzy sees that the bear figurine has been put inside a little cage, whereas those of the Lemmings are gathered around a mini-jar of chocolate spread, he decides to join in the party and take control of his own figurine.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy discovers a new generation Tamagotchi game on the Ranger's tablet: the camera scans the player and gives him a virtual avatar of himself to take care of. You must feed it, put it to bed, play with it... Grizzy takes his new responsibility as a parent very seriously, but the Lemmings decide to complete the virtual Grizzy's education with far more intense activities.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: Grizzy and the Lemmings find a native American Indian vase with a genie inside that will make anyone's dreams come true, if they only let him out by rubbing the vase. There is nonetheless one little snag: the effects of the genie's magic instantly wear off as soon as he returns to his vase and the lid shuts.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings get their hands on a secret weapon that belongs to the Canadian Army: anyone hit with it becomes non-violent. They use the arm to transform Grizzy into a cherub, despite himself.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they discover a super fun app that allows you to see yourself as a rabbit or a robot or something else decked out with lots of animated accessories, Grizzy and the Lemmings fight over the tablet. But if they insist on arguing and refuse to share their virtual costumes, they could end up smashing each other's faces in for real.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: When they find an old book on traditional Japanese origami, the Lemmings churn out paper birds to play gliding games. programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

But is it wise to frustrate a gang of Lemmings who've been inspired by a gag-filled cartoon?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

The Lemmings find a way around this by increasing the power of a lamp that accelerates plant growth and instantly expand themselves to... bear size.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2
programme.desc: The Lemmings lay their hands on a full crate of chocolate spread, which they hide somewhere behind Grizzy's back. And since the Lemmings are both prudent and cunning, it's impossible to surprise them when they pay a visit to their secret hoard. Until the day Grizzy discovers a magic ring that enables him to take on the appearance of a Lemming.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings - Season 2

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

Things go from bad to worse when Mr Bean takes a short cut across the field and gets caught up in a flock of real sheep!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series - Season 4

programme.title: Solar Opposites 1
programme.desc: When the Pupa turns orange, Korvo realizes he left important Pupa information in his wallet on Shlorp. Returning to the present, they realize the Pupa merely ate something orange, but the time stream has been altered and they now live with Vanbo, an obnoxious Shlorpian. Returning to the past to set things right, Korvo and Terry learn they did not want each other as evacuation partners, but reconcile and beat up Vanbo. programme.desc: One year after escaping the destruction of their planet Shlorp and crashing on Earth, aliens Korvo, Terry, and their child-replicants Yumyulack and Jesse adjust to their new lives. Korvo is determined to repair their spaceship, but Terry introduces him to the television show Funbucket. Realizing that the titular alien is fictional, they create a real Funbucket, who tires of them and befriends humans Travis and Avery. Forced to attend high school, Yumyulack and Jesse are menaced by their classmates and faculty. They shrink a bully named Lydia, hoping to use her to study human behavior. As the Shlorpian family have dinner together, it is revealed that their pet, the Pupa, will one day evolve and destroy Earth to terraform a new Shlorp.

programme.title: Solar Opposites 1
programme.desc: Korvo and Terry place nanobots in the city's water supply to spy on their neighbors. The nanobots form a sentient person that runs for president as well, and all three expose embarrassing secrets about their neighbors, who break out in violence. The incumbent president Ruth restores order and turns the crowd against Korvo, Terry, and the nanobot person, who escapes from Korvo. Jesse – concerned that Yumyulack is shrinking and capturing too many humans – uses technology to manipulate people who were mean to Yumyulack, hoping to teach him that humans are generally kind.

programme.title: Le Manas'66. Plento karaliai
programme.desc: Dviem Oskarais apdovanota, tikrais įvykiais paremta juosta apie lenktynes, pakeitusias „Ford“ markės automobilių istoriją. Prestižinėse „Le Mano“ lenktynėse karaliaujantis „Ferrari“ buvo nenugalimas. Tačiau tai įkvėpė „Ford“ vadovą Henrį Fordą II siekti sėkmės bet kokia kaina. Jis žengė rizikingą ir labai abejotiną sėkmę žadantį žingsnį. Į komandą pasikvietęs genialų ir talentingą lenktynininką Keną Mailsą (Christian Bale) ir išradingąjį inžinierių Kerolą Šelbį (Matt Damon) jis davė savo komandai tris mėnesius iki naujų lenktynių. Po alinančio darbo, įtampos ir bemiegių naktų, tai, kas atrodė neįmanoma, tapo realybe. Visiškai naujas „Ford GT40” nuvertė nuo sosto „Ferrari“ ir buvo nepralenkiamas trejus metus. „Ford GT40“ modelis tapo legenda ir geriausiai atpažįstamu automobilių pasaulio istorijoje.

programme.title: Ledynmetis 2. Eros pabaiga
programme.desc: Žemę dengiantis ledas pradeda tirpti, visiems priešistoriniams gyvūnams suteikdamas daug džiaugsmo. Dabar jie gali maudytis, šokinėti nuo tramplinų, grožėtis geizeriais ar turkštis natūraliose purvo voniose. Niekas net neįtaria, kad artėjantis potvynis gali sunaikinti visą slėnį. Laimei, apie tai pirmieji sužino mamutas Manfredas, tigras Diegas ir tinginys Sidas. Šaunioji trijulė ne tik privalo perspėti visus apie gresiantį pavojų, bet ir sugalvoti būdą, kaip pasprukti nuo artėjančio potvynio!

programme.title: Ledynmetis 3
programme.desc: Elinį kartą besivaikydamas gilę Skretas netikėtai susipažįsta su evoliucijos keliu šiek tiek toliau pažengusia vovere skraiduole, viliokliškai klapsinčia savo ilgomis blakstienomis. Mamutas Menis su naująja savo drauge Eli laukiasi mažylio. Kardadantis tigras ima pastebimai nervintis, kad jį visi laiko vos ne namine kate. Sidas, prisižiūrėjęs į savo draugą mamutą, ir pats užsinori sukurti šeimą bei iš to begalinio noro pavagia dinozauro kiaušinį. Žinoma, tai buvo klaida. Šaunieji „Ledynmečio“ herojai priversti leistis į pavojingą kelionę, kad išvaduotų savo draugą iš paslaptingo, nepažįstamo ir bauginančio pasaulio. Šioje nuotykių nestokojančioje odisėjoje jiems teks susidurti su naujais pavojais. Tačiau vieni jie neliks. Jiems padės naujas veikėjas – negailestinga vienaakė dinozaurus medžiojanti žebenkštis, vardu Bakas.

programme.title: Kietas riešutėlis
programme.desc: Briusas Vilisas šiuo filmu įsitvirtino pasaulio kine kaip įspūdingas pagrindinių vaidmenų atlikėjas. Niujorko policininkas Džonas Makleinas atvyksta į Los Andželą aplankyti žmonos, kuri darbovietėje linksminasi Kalėdų vakarėlyje. Staiga pastatą užgrobia teroristai. Profesinė pareiga, žmoniškumas ir meilė suteikia ryžto stoti į žūtbūtinį mūšį.

programme.title: Kietas riešutėlis 2
programme.desc: Kieto riešutėlio“ tęsinyje į Los Andželą persikraustęs policininkas Džonas Makleinas (akt. Bruce Willis) laukia grįžtančios žmonos Daleso oro uoste Vašingtone. Tačiau staiga oro uostą užgrobia ginkluoti asmenys, siekiantys išvaduoti stambų prekeivį narkotikais ir išgabenti jį į Karibus. Makleino ir vėl laukia sunki užduotis, su kuria nepajėgtų susidoroti nė vienas kitas policininkas...

programme.title: Baris Sylas. Amerikos sukčius
programme.desc: Paini, paslaptinga, neįtikėtina ir tikra istorija apie pilotą Barį Sylą (aktorius Tom‘as Cruise‘as). Pilotuoti lėktuvą išmokęs vos 15-os metų, devintajame praėjusio amžiaus dešimtmetyje Baris buvo vienas geriausių aviakompanijos TWA lakūnų. Būtent tuomet jį užverbavo CŽV, tikėdamasi panaudoti savo operacijose prieš Centrinės Amerikos šalyse stiprėjančias komunistų organizacijas.Tačiau tikrovė pranoko visus lūkesčius. Pastebėję lakūno gabumus, į Barį dėmesį atkreipė legendinio Medeljino narkotikų kartelio atstovai. CŽV užverbuotas lakūnas greitai tapo vienu pagrindinių narkotikų kurjerių ir itin naudingu amerikiečių informatoriumi. Painus melo, įtampos, paslapčių, politikos, nusikaltimų ir milžiniškų pinigų voratinklis savo aukų taip paprastai nepaleidžia...

programme.title: Pilietinis karas
programme.desc: Jungtinėse Amerikos Valstijose siaučia nevaldomas pilietinis karas. Nepasitenkinimą valdžia reiškianti visuomenė nebeturi ko prarasti ir imasi drastiškų veiksmų. Keturių patyrusių Niujorko žurnalistų komanda nutaria keliauti į Vašingtoną. Jų tikslas – paimti interviu iš autoritariniu diktatoriumi virtusio šalies prezidento (akt. Nick Offerman). Jau tris kadencijas iš eilės valdantis prezidentas jaučia artėjančią grėsmę, o jo vadovaujamos specialiosios pajėgos desperatiškai bando išlaikyti kontrolę. Žurnalistų kelionė tampa tikru išbandymu. Karo fotografė Li (akt. Kirsten Dunst), jos kolega žurnalistas Džoelis (akt. Wagner Moura), veteranas reporteris Semis (akt, Stephen McKinley Henderson) ir jauna, tik ką pradėjusi dirbti fotografė Džesė (akt. Cailee Spaeny) stengiasi likti neutraliais stebėtojais. Bet kiekvieną kelionės akimirką jiems tenka susidurti su kankinimais, masinėmis kapavietėmis, nevaldomu smurtu ir šalį niokojančia agresija. Nepaisydami pavojaus, fiksuodami įvykius, žurnalistai tęsia kelionę ir pasiekia Baltuosius rūmus. Visuotinio šturmo metu į susišaudymą patekusi Li žūsta, o jos kolegos tampa įsiveržimo į Ovalųjį kabinetą liudininkais. Prieš pat kariams įvykdant egzekuciją, Džoelis sustabdo juos, kad gautų paskutiniąją prezidento citatą.

programme.title: Kodused teaduseksperimendid
programme.desc: Kuidas teha ise kodus müstiliselt ägedaid teaduskatseid? Saatejuht Steve selgitab ning annab nõu.

programme.title: Teaduspauk
programme.desc: Teadus-mustkunstnik Eric jagab saladusi teaduse, tehnoloogia, inseneriteaduse ja matemaatika maailmast, et õpetada lastele, kuidas üllatada oma sõpru ja perekonda STEM-põhiste võlutrikkide ja käsitööga! Kujutage ette, et saate teha telefonile kõlarid vaid mõnest tavalisest majapidamises kasutatavast esemest või luua kõrgelennulise raketi pudeli, sooda ja veega. See kõik on võimalik läbi teaduse jõu!

programme.title: Ahne aju
programme.desc: Lõbus sari, mis süveneb meie maailma põnevatesse avastustesse, täis huvitavaid fakte ajaloo, teaduse, spordi, moe, isetegemise, retseptide, loomade ja maagia kohta.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Hiiglaslikud teaduskatsed
programme.desc: Mis saab siis, kui tavalisest teaduskatsest teha midagi tõeliselt suurt? Suur läbikukkumine? Või hoopis ülipõnev ja kohutavalt lõbus etendus?

programme.title: Ajurünnak
programme.desc: Oled sa kunagi mõelnud, kas ilma tiibadeta on võimalik lennata? Või kõndida mööda vesiliiva? Kaks last esitavad võimatuna näiva väljakutse ning sukelduvad koos saatejuhtidega teadusmaailma.

programme.title: Noored kangelased
programme.desc: Põnev sari, kus lapsed võistlevad kahes suures väljakutses, mis on inspireeritud tõestisündinud kangelasteost.

programme.title: Andy metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Andy ja Kipi metsikud seiklused viivad nad üle maailma veidrate ja imeliste loomade otsinguile.

programme.title: Hirmus ajalugu
programme.desc: See on energiline, üllatav ja tavapäratu kujutlus ajaloo kõige jubedamatest, kuid samas naljakamatest sündmustest. Muserdavatest maailmasõdadest ja kurvast keskajast võikate viikingite ning kihvtide kreeklasteni. Ajalugu pole kunagi olnud nii ulakas.

programme.title: Andy reisiseiklused
programme.desc: Andy, Jen ja Scout reisivad oma keskkonnasõbraliku masinaga mööda maailma ja avastavad looduse saladusi ning loomade uskumatut käitumist.

programme.title: Matapauk
programme.desc: Eric Leclerc on matemaatik ja otsekui mustkunstnik näitab ta meile kui müstiliselt huvitav on matemaatika, mis peidab end kõikjal meie ümber. Matapauk õpetab väga lõbusal ja huvitaval kombel meid kõiki matemaatikat armastama.

programme.title: Briti parim noor pagar
programme.desc: Kuulsaima küpsetussaate variant noorte meistritega. 9 - 13aastased noored annavad endast kõik, et saada oma oskuste ja originaalsete retseptidega maa parimaks pagariks.

programme.title: Vägevad masinad
programme.desc: Mootorrattur Grace istub juhiistmel ja tutvustab publikule maailma suurimaid, kiiremaid ja vägevamaid masinaid.

programme.title: Imeline Planeet
programme.desc: Selles kaasahaaravas teadussarjas avastab Jacques Cousteau kõige imelisemaid paiku Maa peal, Maa sees ja Maa kohal. Uskumatud rännakud meie imelise planeedi kõrgeimate mägede tippudest kuni sügavaimate paikadeni ookeanides.

programme.title: Loomade jutud
programme.desc: Lõbus ja hariv saade loomadest nii looduses kui koduaias. Igas osas saame teada huvitavaid ja üllatavaid tõsiasju ning mis kõige toredam, loomad ise räägivad endist...

programme.title: Joonistame koos
programme.desc: Maailmakuulsate Marveli, Ämblikmehe ja Tähesõdade koomiksiraamatute kunstnik Will Sliney näitab, kuidas joonistada tegelasi maailma tuntumatest multikatest, nagu näiteks „Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks“, „Vali maja“, „Boss Beebi“, „Käpapatrull“ ja paljud teised.

programme.title: Andy veeseiklused
programme.desc: Andy naaseb vaimustavate veeseiklustega. Avasta temaga koos veekogusid üle kogu maakera ning kohtu delfiinide, vaalade ja muude hämmastavate loomadega.

programme.title: Svajonių laivas. Vankuveris
programme.desc: Šioje kelionėje daug darbo tenka laivo gydytojai Džesikai Delgado. Net keli keleiviai reikalauja ypatingos medicininės priežiūros.Korina Sandler serga išsėtine skleroze ir desperatiškai trokšta rasti atsakymus į jai ramybės neduodančius klausimus. Drauge su sužadėtiniu Tariku Steinu, ji leidžiasi į Kanados miškus ieškoti žmogaus, parašiusio knygą apie šią klastingą ligą. Mergina tiki, kad susitikimas suteiks informacijos, kaip toliau gyventi turint tokią diagnozę. Gerus ketinimus nutraukia dar vienas ligos paūmėjimas. Po žmonos mirties nutrūksta Rainerio Chromo santykiai su paaugliu sūnumi Niklasu. Tėvo ir sūnaus kelionė skirta suartėjimui. Bet viskas pasikeičia, kai Vankuveryje Raineris pamato savo sūnų tarp drag queenų. Jo siaubui Niklas vilki suknelę. Ar Raineris sugebės priimti naują sūnaus pusę?Laivo personalui vadovaujantis Martinas Grimms iš laivybos kompanijos gauna pasiūlymą tapti kito laivo kapitonu. Martinas nori šį pasiūlymą aptarti su kapitonu Pargeriu, bet jų išvyka baigiasi netikėtai. Vyrai priversti praleisti naktį Kanados gamtoje. Tarp jų kyla ginčas ir dabar jau nėra aišku, ką nuspręs Martinas Grimas dėl savo ateities.

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Svajonių laivas. Volvis Bėjus
programme.desc: Laivui išplaukus iš uosto kapitono Pargerio kajutėje randamas krepšys su kūdikiu. Šalia paliktame raštelyje parašyta, kad tai – kapitono vaikas. Nei Pargeris, nei personalui vadovaujantis Martinas neįsivaizduoja iš kur atsirado šis krepšys su mažu berniuku. Mažyliu reikia rūpintis nuo ryto iki vakaro ir čia į pagalbą atskuba visi laivo darbuotojai.Svajonių laivu keliauja ir penkiasdešimtmetis Robertas, tikėjęsis praleisti laiką su daug jaunesne mylimąja. Mergina ketino švęsti savo gimtadienį, tad pakvietė ir savo vyresnę seserį Klaudiją vykti drauge. Deja, ant denio Robertas sutinka tik Klaudiją, nes Julijana pavėlavo atvykti. Robertui ir Klaudijai tenka bendrauti, leisti laiką vienas kito kompanijoje ir netrukus įsižiebia abipusė simpatija. Deja, senų įpročių ne taip lengva atsisakyti. Klaudija dar kartą įsitikiną, kad Robertas – ne toks vyras, kokio ji linkėtų savo sesutei.Sėkminga verslininkė Barbara Niuman keliauja į Namibiją su dukra Liza. Laive jos susipažįsta su kelionių organizatore, Afrikoje užaugusia Johana. Pamačiusi Johaną, Barbara tampa lyg ne sava. Pasirodo, prieš daugybę metų ligoninėje buvo apkeisti kūdikiai. Šeimos, išsiaiškinusios šį aplaidumą, nutarė nieko nekeisti, auginti ne savo biologines dukras. Po daugelio metų Barbara trokšta nusimesti slegiančią paslaptį ir supažindinti Lizą su tikraisiais, biologiniais tėvais. Tačiau biologinis Lizos tėvas tam prieštarauja. Jis reikalauja laikytis susitarimo. Ar ūkyje Namibijoje bus atskleista daugelio metų paslaptis?

programme.title: Inspektorius Mažylis
programme.desc: Populiarus aktorius M. Jampolskis premjeroje atlieka pagrindinį – nedidelio miestelio policijos inspektoriaus Andriaus Mažylio – vaidmenį. Filme policininką visur lydi jo tarnybinis vokiečių aviganis, vardu Mažylis. Su šunimi į gimtąjį miestelį grįžęs dirbti Andrius po keleto metų, praleistų policijos akademijoje, randa labai pasikeitusią aplinką: dabar čia viską valdo nusikaltėliai ir korumpuoti vietos valdininkai. A. Mažyliui su bendravardžiu šunimi teks gerokai paplušėti, kad gimtinėje vėl viešpatautų tvarka ir ramybė. Filmo kūrėjai sako, kad šiame detektyve netrūks ir meilės istorijų, o siužetas bus įdomus visai šeimai: „Inspektoriaus Mažylio“ nuotykiai pasakojami su ironijos gaidele, humoristiniais pasisakymais, su šypsena žvelgiant į šviesiąsias gyvenimo puses.

programme.title: Ieškant dukros
programme.desc: Žiaurų likimo smūgį patyrusi Hidžran niekaip negali susitaikyti su kūdikio praradimu. Mintys apie gimdymo metu mirusią dukrelę lydi moterį kiekviename žingsnyje. Nors gydytojai ligoninėje teigė, kad kūdikis neišgyveno, Hidžran nuojauta kužda ką kita. Troškimas sutikti dukrelę dega jaunos moters širdyje ir suteikia jėgų gyventi.Vieną dieną Hidžran pamato šalikelje stovinčiame automobilyje dūstančią mergaitę. Moteris nelieka abejinga ir puola gelbėti mažylę. Nepaisydama savo saugumo, ji sugeba ištraukti negaluojančią mergaitę iš automobilio. Deja, netrukus pasirodžiusiam jos tėvui Emre ši situacija pasirodo labiau panaši į vaiko pagrobimą, nei į norą padėti. Hidžran sulaikoma ir ilgai tardoma dėl šio incidento. Laimei, peržiūrėję gatvę filmuojančių vaizdo kamerų įrašus, pareigūnai išleidžia Hidžran į laisvę. Mažosios Melek tėvas privalo atsiprašyti geraširdės moters. Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.

programme.title: Svajonių laivas. Volvis Bėjus
programme.desc: Laivui išplaukus iš uosto kapitono Pargerio kajutėje randamas krepšys su kūdikiu. Šalia paliktame raštelyje parašyta, kad tai – kapitono vaikas. Nei Pargeris, nei personalui vadovaujantis Martinas neįsivaizduoja iš kur atsirado šis krepšys su mažu berniuku. Mažyliu reikia rūpintis nuo ryto iki vakaro ir čia į pagalbą atskuba visi laivo darbuotojai.Svajonių laivu keliauja ir penkiasdešimtmetis Robertas, tikėjęsis praleisti laiką su daug jaunesne mylimąja. Mergina ketino švęsti savo gimtadienį, tad pakvietė ir savo vyresnę seserį Klaudiją vykti drauge. Deja, ant denio Robertas sutinka tik Klaudiją, nes Julijana pavėlavo atvykti. Robertui ir Klaudijai tenka bendrauti, leisti laiką vienas kito kompanijoje ir netrukus įsižiebia abipusė simpatija. Deja, senų įpročių ne taip lengva atsisakyti. Klaudija dar kartą įsitikiną, kad Robertas – ne toks vyras, kokio ji linkėtų savo sesutei.Sėkminga verslininkė Barbara Niuman keliauja į Namibiją su dukra Liza. Laive jos susipažįsta su kelionių organizatore, Afrikoje užaugusia Johana. Pamačiusi Johaną, Barbara tampa lyg ne sava. Pasirodo, prieš daugybę metų ligoninėje buvo apkeisti kūdikiai. Šeimos, išsiaiškinusios šį aplaidumą, nutarė nieko nekeisti, auginti ne savo biologines dukras. Po daugelio metų Barbara trokšta nusimesti slegiančią paslaptį ir supažindinti Lizą su tikraisiais, biologiniais tėvais. Tačiau biologinis Lizos tėvas tam prieštarauja. Jis reikalauja laikytis susitarimo. Ar ūkyje Namibijoje bus atskleista daugelio metų paslaptis?

programme.title: Meilei nėra recepto
programme.desc: Darbšti ir maloni visiems aplinkiniams Paz Roble patiria siaubingą vyro išdavystę. Prasiskolinęs sutuoktinis vietoj išpirkos nusprendžia skolininkams atiduoti savo naujagimę dukrą. Dukrelės netekusi Paz nebegali rasti sielos ramybės ir nusprendžia visą savo laiką skirti dingusios mažylės paieškoms. Šeimos restoranas, kuriame Paz ilgus metus darbavosi, dėl skolų ir sutuoktinių barnių dabar stovi užkaltais langais.Sėkmingas verslininkas Estebanas Vila de Cortesas netikėtai tampa našliu. Mirus žmonai vyras lieka su trimis vaikais ir dideliu skausmu širdyje. Dar blogiau, kad jo anyta Elvira laiko jį kaltu dėl savo dukros mirties. Moteris dega keršto troškimu ir tikisi sužlugdyti Estebaną.Netikėta Paz ir Estebano pažintis vėl uždega abiejų širdyse viltį ir tikėjimą. Estebanas pasiūlo jai darbuotis jo namų virtuvėje. Paz nedvejodama sutinka su šiuo pasiūlymu, nes nieko kito taip nesiilgėjo, kaip vėl gaminti mylimiems žmonėms.Ar Estebano ir Paz jausmai atlaikys jų šeimų keliamus iššūkius? Kaip į Paz reaguos kerštingoji Elvira? Ar Estebanas sugebės apsaugoti mylimąją? Ar jis padės atrasti jai prarastą dukrą?

programme.title: Briusterio milijonai
programme.desc: Nevykėlis beisbolo žaidėjas Briusteris netikėtai sužino, kad mirė jo giminaitis. Pasirodo, šis buvo turtuolis ir paliko Briusteriui visą savo kapitalą. Tačiau turčius buvo tikras keistuolis, todėl Briusteris, norėdamas užvaldyti milžiniškus pinigus, turi per 30 dienų išleisti 30 milijonų. Manote, lengva iššvaistyti tiek pinigų? Visai nelengva, ypač kai niekam nė žodeliu negali prasitarti, iš kur juos gavai ir kodėl taip išlaidauji...

programme.title: Angelas sargas
programme.desc: Šivradžas ir Rasal – vienas kitą mylintys brolis ir sesuo. Netekę mylimos mamos, vaikai užgauliojami bendraamžių ir engiami kaimynų. Brolis jaučia didelę atsakomybę apsaugoti mažąją sesutę, tad tampa tikru apsaugos skydu kasdieniuose iššūkiuose. Gyvenimas pasisuka dramatiškai, kai vaiku tėvas patenka į avariją ir susiduria su paslaptingos ginkluotos grupuotės nariais. Dabar vaikams teks dar labiau saugoti vienam kitą. Ar meilė ir ištikimybė padės išlikti kartu klastinguose gyvenimo posūkiuose? Ar blogo linkintys niekšai palauš vaikų pasitikėjimą vienas kitu?

programme.title: Be namų
programme.desc: Serialas sukurtas remiantis Daivos Vaitkevičiūtės apysaka „Trise prieš mafiją“, kuri 2006 m. pripažinta „Metų knyga“ paauglių kategorijoje ir yra leidžiama vis naujais tiražais. „Be namų“ – tai gyvenimiška drama, kurioje susipina jautrūs vaikų likimai, detektyvinės mįslės bei nuoširdi draugystė, lydima įkvepiančių svajonių, linksmų ir šiurpių nuotykių. Serialo centre – vaikų globos namų auklėtinė Emilija ir jos draugai – našlaitis, pravarde Kobė, ir Kasparas. Šio tėvai mįslingai dingsta. Veiksmas rutuliojasi mažame Lietuvos miestelyje, kuriame daug saulės, bet mažai meilės. Vietinių globos namų auklėtiniai kasdien susiduria ne tik su geraširde direktore ir rūpestingu ūkvedžiu, bet ir su žiauria auklėtoja.

programme.title: Vasara Kretoje
programme.desc: Izabela Burger atvyksta į kerinčio grožio Kretos salą, kur turi sutvarkyti teisinius tėvo palikimo klausimus. Mergina po tėvo mirties paveldi jo ilgus metus puoselėtą vilą ir alyvmedžių plantaciją. Kadangi ji neketina apsigyventi Kretoje, vienintelis tinkamas planas – kuo greičiau rasti pirkėją paveldėtam turtui. Tačiau po pokalbio su notaru Eliasu, mergina sužino, kad viloje vis dar gyvena buvusi jos tėvo Klauso žmona Sofija ir jo sūnus Silas, bei anūkas Nikas. Paaiškėja, kad teisiškai našle tapusi moteris gali ten gyventi, tačiau – ką tuo atveju daryti Izabelai? Juk išmesti į gatvę trijų asmenų ji negali! Nelieka nieko kito, tik važiuoti į paveldėtą vilą ir susitarti su Sofija.

programme.title: Gero vakaro šou
programme.desc: Nestokojant puikaus humoro čia kalbinami žymūs Lietuvos žmonės, netikėtais kampais atskleidžiant jų portretus. Justinas ir Mindaugas garantuoja, kad „Gero vakaro šou“ pokalbiai nebus nuobodūs, o svečiai kaskart sulauks labai netikėtų klausimų.

Jis puikiai supranta, kad tik Hidžran dėka jo mažoji dukrelė vis dar gyva.Sužinojęs, kad Hidžran ieško darbo, Emre nedvejodamas pasiūlo jai dirbti prabangiuose savo namuose ir būti Melek aukle. Mergina sutinka ir apsigyvena Melek šeimos dvare. Nuo pat pirmos akimirkos auklė pakliūva į siautulingą intrigų liūną. Šeimą skaldo dramatiškos paslaptys, kova dėl valdžios ir chaosas. Tačiau dabar visi likimo smūgiai tampa pakeliami, nes Melek ir Hidžran turi viena kitą. Mergaitės ir jos auklės tandemą apgaubia pasitikėjimo, pagarbos ir meilės skydas, nors jos net nenutuokia, kad yra motina ir dukra.
